name: forgeboard
description: An internal project tracker used as a codebase onboarding exercise.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @forgeboard/api" "npm run dev -w @forgeboard/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @forgeboard/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
